title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Employees
tiers.description: Every employee of the Group, including all Directors and Senior Management, plus a company or trust controlled by a Director, Senior Manager or Employee and their spouse, children, close relatives acting in concert, or financially dependent persons. All substantive prohibitions apply to this tier.

tiers.name: Chair of the Board
tiers.description: Chair of the Board; distinguished only for clearance (the chair of the Audit and Risk Management Committee is the Authorising Officer).

tiers.name: Other directors, Company Secretary and any other Key Management Personnel
tiers.description: Directors other than the Chair, the Company Secretary and other KMP; distinguished only for clearance (the chair of the Board, or the chair of the Audit and Risk Management Committee in the Chair's absence).

tiers.name: Any other Employee
tiers.description: All Employees other than Directors and Senior Management; distinguished only for clearance (the Chief Executive Officer).

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: A company or trust controlled by a Director, Senior Manager or Employee; a spouse (including de facto), child (including step-child or adopted child), a close relative acting in concert, or a person financially dependent on or acting in concert with any Director, Senior Manager or Employee.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Employees may not, at any time, directly or indirectly, grant any form of security ... over any Vulcan securities to secure any obligation of that Employee or any third party or enter into any margin lending arrangement involving Vulcan securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded collar secured on the collared shares is prohibited outright for all Employees and Associates at all times, with no clearance mechanism referenced anywhere in the policy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The entering into of all types of "protection arrangements" for any Vulcan securities (or Vulcan products in the derivatives markets) ... is prohibited in respect of any Vulcan securities which are unvested or subject to a holding lock; and otherwise, requires consent under clause 5.2.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar's put and call together fall squarely within 'protection arrangements', so even absent the financing ban, the derivative legs are absolutely barred over unvested or holding-locked shares and, over vested unrestricted shares, need Board-level exceptional-circumstances consent rather than routine preclearance.

bespoke_clauses.clause: What constitutes "exceptional circumstances" will be assessed on a case-by-case basis within the absolute discretion of the Board, and may include, without limitation, severe financial hardship or a requirement to comply with a court order or court enforceable undertaking.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Consent for a protection arrangement over vested shares is not a routine sign-off but requires the Board to find genuinely exceptional circumstances, making timing and certainty of execution for a bank-structured collar unpredictable.

bespoke_clauses.clause: a company or trust controlled by a Director, Senior Manager and Employee; and a spouse ... child ... a close relative (if acting in concert), a person financially dependent on or acting in concert with any Director, Senior Manager or Employee (and any company or trust controlled by any of them)
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Routing the collar or loan through a family trust or controlled company does not avoid the secured-financing ban or the protection-arrangement restrictions.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Employees may not, at any time ... enter into any margin lending arrangement involving Vulcan securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Because secured lending is banned outright, the policy contains no exemption for a lender's enforcement sale (unlike policies that permit margin loans with clearance), so there is no fallback mechanism for lender enforcement to rely on.

summary: A funded collar is not available under this policy. Clause 6.3 bans, at any time and without any clearance route, granting security over Vulcan securities or entering into margin lending arrangements, so the loan leg secured on the collared shares is prohibited outright for the executive, directors and their associates. Independently, the put and call together constitute a 'protection arrangement' under clause 6.2, which is banned absolutely over unvested or holding-locked shares and, over vested unrestricted shares, may proceed only with consent under clause 5.2 — a discretion confined to Board-assessed 'exceptional circumstances' such as severe financial hardship or a court order, not routine preclearance. Any dealing must also fall within a Trading Window or be separately excused, and short-term or speculative trading (including via CFDs and exchange-traded options) is banned outright with no stated duration threshold. There is no carve-out for a secured lender's enforcement sale, consistent with secured financing being prohibited in the first place, so both legs of a bank-structured funded collar are blocked as the policy is currently drafted.
